title: publish-release.mjs must refuse to publish without an opum-cli-e2e qualification receipt for the exact SHA and tarballs
description: Filed on opum-agent dispatch OPAG-379 (2026-09-24T05:34Z), file-only; the orchestrator decides when it is implemented. The ruling is ruling 3 of opum-doc docs/adr/harden-fleet-ci-against-a-single-runner-outage-and-unqualified-publication.md, read here at main 9222079 (committed 2026-09-23T23:57:37-05:00) rather than taken from the relay. The publisher hard-refuses without a qualification receipt from opum-cli-e2e unless an explicit override is written to the record it reads. A warning-only mode was considered and rejected. The ADR names publish-release.sh; this repository equivalent is scripts/publish-release.mjs, which today gates only on the native-execution receipt from this repo own qualification workflow, not on opum-cli-e2e. Motivating incident: lore 0.9.0 shipped while opum-cli-e2e TASK-103 recorded the pair NOT QUALIFIED. Note for whoever implements this: quest 0.10.0 (QCLI-365) was itself published 2026-09-24 at about 05:40Z with no opum-cli-e2e receipt. That was after the ADR, and after the orchestrator said not to interrupt that release for this.

acceptanceCriteria.text: publish-release.mjs refuses a real publish, exiting non-zero before any npm write, when no opum-cli-e2e qualification receipt binds the exact commit SHA and the tarball digests being published
An explicit override is accepted only when written to the record the publisher reads, and the publish output names that override
Proven both ways: a run with no receipt refuses, and a run with a matching receipt proceeds to the dry-run stage
The receipt format and location are agreed with opum-cli-e2e rather than invented here

implementationNotes: Handoff 2026-09-25: still file-only; timing is opum-agent. The ADR ruling already binds publication, per the orchestrator 2026-09-24T13:41Z. Coordinate with QCLI-368: a gate that binds tarball digests will fail on the two win32 packages until that mismatch is fixed.

Implemented on feat/QCLI-366-e2e-receipt-gate. FORMAT: opum-cli-e2es, from lore-cli LCLI-578 at origin/dev, not redesigned. Mapping confirmed by opum-cli-e2e 2026-09-25 by message, with fixture receipts/quest/0.10.0.json in opum-ai/opum-cli-e2e#248: releaseRunId is the prepublication-qualification run on the tag that uploaded quest-candidate-bundle (release.yml builds no tarballs); tarballs are exactly the 7 bundle .tgz files, set equality; commit is the tag peel, which equals the bundle sourceCommit. DESIGN: new scripts/qualification/e2e-receipt.mjs. publish-release.mjs now requires --qualification-run <id>: it checks the run is prepublication-qualification of HEAD with conclusion success, downloads the bundle, gates on the receipt (dry run too), then publishes the bundle .tgz files byte-for-byte, not a working-tree repack, so the gated bytes are the published bytes. release.yml gets the same gate and publishes bundle files; it reads with secrets.E2E_RECEIPT_READ_TOKEN and falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN, which 404s on the private repo and refuses. Creating that secret is a credential action for the user. MEASURED: (1) the real publisher at v0.10.0 in a scratch worktree with the new scripts overlaid, run 35959762162: exit 1, "no opum-cli-e2e qualification receipt ... HTTP 404", before any credential or npm call. (2) requireQualification against the REAL 0.10.0 bundle from that run with the e2e fixture: ok, 0 problems. Tampered digest, NOT QUALIFIED, and wrong run each refuse with exactly one problem; NOT QUALIFIED plus an override passes and returns the override. (3) Mutation: removing the commit binding turned exactly the predicted 1 of 10 unit tests red. (4) bun run check exit 0, 603 tests; lore check exit 0. OPEN for AC3: the matching-receipt run of the full publisher reaching its dry-run stage needs the fixture on opum-cli-e2e main, which awaits promotion of their #248.

DECISION (recorded at the orchestrator's request): both publishers publish the qualified bundle .tgz files byte-for-byte (npm publish <file>) and never npm publish in npm/<pkg>, which repacks the working tree. Reason: a receipt binds tarball digests, so the gate only means something if the digest-checked file is the file npm receives. Consequence: this closes the QCLI-368 repack path for every gated publish. QCLI-368 remains open for its own root cause (CRLF in the win32 package files in the working tree) and for 0.9.0/0.10.0 already on npm. REVIEW (opum-workflow reviewer, head b7b46a6): no way to publish bytes other than the qualified ones; three weakening findings, all fixed. F1: `in` accepted inherited keys (__proto__, constructor, ...) as extra receipt tarballs; now Object.hasOwn. F2: override {} or [] waived the verdict; now it needs by/reason/task/adr as non-empty strings. F3: the local publisher skipped an already-published package without comparing bytes; it now compares npm dist.integrity with the qualified tarball sha512 and refuses on a mismatch. The reviewer probe passed F1 and F2 before the fix and refuses them after. F3 was measured on real 0.10.0: 5 of 7 hold the qualified bytes, and both win32 packages DIFFER, which independently confirms the QCLI-368 mismatch here. runAttempt stays unbound by design: identity is the digests. AC3 MATCHING HALF: the real publisher at v0.10.0 (scratch worktree, scripts overlaid), run 35959762162, with receipts/quest/0.10.0.json on opum-cli-e2e main 0d2f588. The gate passed ("binds 0.10.0 at bf30c5c, run 35959762162, and all 7 tarballs") and the run reached npm publish --dry-run of the bundle tarball. npm then declined because 0.10.0 already exists ("You cannot publish over the previously published versions"), which is npm's own check and expected for a released version. bun run check exit 0 (606 tests), lore check exit 0.
finalSummary: Publication now hard-refuses without an opum-cli-e2e qualification receipt (opum-doc ADR harden-fleet-ci...-unqualified-publication, ruling 3). WHAT: new scripts/qualification/e2e-receipt.mjs reads receipts/quest/<version>.json from opum-cli-e2e main, in the format agreed on lore-cli LCLI-578 and not forked. It binds version, commit, the prepublication-qualification run id and set-equal sha256s of all 7 candidate-bundle tarballs, passing on verdict QUALIFIED; a receipt-only override (by/reason/task/adr) waives the verdict alone and is printed verbatim. A 403, 404 or unreadable receipt refuses. publish-release.mjs requires --qualification-run, checks that run qualified HEAD, downloads its bundle, gates before any credential or npm call (dry run included), publishes the bundle tarballs byte-for-byte, and refuses to skip an already-published package whose npm integrity differs from the qualified tarball. release.yml applies the same gate and publishes the same files; it refuses until an E2E_RECEIPT_READ_TOKEN secret exists, a credential decision left to the owner. VERIFIED: the real publisher at v0.10.0 refused with exit 1 on a 404 before the receipt existed, and passed the gate and reached npm publish --dry-run once receipts/quest/0.10.0.json was on opum-cli-e2e main 0d2f588. The real 0.10.0 bundle was checked against tampered, NOT QUALIFIED, override and wrong-run receipts. A mutation turned exactly the predicted 1 of 10 tests red. An independent reviewer pass found no path to publishing unqualified bytes; its three weakening findings were fixed and re-probed. bun run check exit 0 (606 tests); lore check exit 0. PR opum-ai/quest-cli#254.
